(async function () {
    const checks = [];
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const check = (condition, label) => { if (!condition) throw Error(label); checks.push(label); };
    const until = async (predicate) => { const end = Date.now() + 8000; while (!await predicate()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw Error("Timed out waiting: " + predicate); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20)); } };
    const fixtureRequests = () => fetch("/fixture/requests").then((response) => response.json());
    const setupMode = (body) => fetch("/fixture/setup-mode", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    const pointer = (target, type, props = {}) => target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 4, clientX: 350, clientY: 350, button: 0, ...props }));
    await until(() => $("project-nav").querySelector("button") && $("kpis").children.length === 4);
    check(!$("view-dashboard").hidden, "dashboard bootstrap");
    $("project-nav").querySelector("button").click();
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelectorAll(".gcard").length === 2 && $("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd") && $("p-graph-tabs").querySelector('[data-graph-tab][aria-selected="true"]'));
    check(!$("view-project").hidden, "project navigation and graph rendering");
    let canvas = $("p-graph").querySelector(".graph-canvas");
    const firstCard = canvas.querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"]');
    const command = canvas.querySelector(".gcmd");
    check(canvas.querySelectorAll("path.edge").length === 1, "graph links rendered");
    const context = (target) => target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("contextmenu", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: 650, clientY: 350 }));
    const menuItem = (label) => [...document.querySelectorAll(".context-menu button")].find((item) => item.textContent === label);
    context($("p-graph"));
    check(menuItem("새 버튼") && menuItem("새 Markdown 출력"), "graph offers button and Markdown output nodes");
    menuItem("새 버튼").click();
    check($("command-dialog").open && !$("button-prompt-row").hidden && $("command-text-row").hidden, "button creation opens prompt-only editor");
    $("command-dialog").close();
    context($("p-graph")); menuItem("새 Markdown 출력").click();
    check($("command-dialog").open && $("button-prompt-row").hidden && $("command-text-row").hidden, "Markdown creation needs no AI prompt or shell command");
    $("command-dialog").close();
    context($("p-graph")); menuItem("새 웹훅 보내기").click();
    check($("command-dialog").open && !$("webhook-settings").hidden && $("webhook-in-settings").hidden && $("webhook-url").required && !$("webhook-body-row").hidden, "webhook send creation shows URL, headers and body");
    $("webhook-method").value = "GET"; $("webhook-method").dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
    check($("webhook-body-row").hidden, "GET webhooks send no body");
    $("command-dialog").close();
    context($("p-graph")); menuItem("새 웹훅 받기").click();
    check($("command-dialog").open && !$("webhook-in-settings").hidden && $("webhook-in-copy").disabled && $("webhook-in-regenerate-row").hidden && !$("webhook-url").required, "new webhook receiver explains its address is created on save");
    $("command-dialog").close();
    const graphRect = $("p-graph").getBoundingClientRect();
    const projectContent = document.querySelector("#view-project > .content");
    const contentBottom = projectContent.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - parseFloat(getComputedStyle(projectContent).paddingBottom);
    const toolbarRect = $("p-flow-assistant").getBoundingClientRect();
    const tabsRect = $("p-graph-tabs").getBoundingClientRect();
    check(Math.abs(toolbarRect.bottom - contentBottom + 1) <= 2 && Math.abs(graphRect.bottom - tabsRect.top) <= 2 && Math.abs(tabsRect.bottom - toolbarRect.top) <= 2 && tabsRect.height > 0 && graphRect.height > 300, "graph fills the available panel height above its tabs and fixed toolbar");
    const graphStaysFixed = () => {
      const rect = $("p-graph").getBoundingClientRect();
      return Math.abs(rect.width - graphRect.width) < 1 && Math.abs(rect.height - graphRect.height) < 1 && Math.abs(rect.bottom - graphRect.bottom) < 1;
    };
    const beforeZoom = canvas.style.transform;
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent("wheel", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, deltaY: -120, clientX: 450, clientY: 300 }));
    check(canvas.style.transform !== beforeZoom && canvas.style.transform.includes("1.2"), "wheel zoom");
    check(graphStaysFixed(), "zoom does not resize the graph panel");
    const panX = parseFloat(canvas.style.left), panY = parseFloat(canvas.style.top);
    pointer($("p-graph"), "pointerdown", { button: 1 });
    pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 390, clientY: 380 });
    check(Math.abs(parseFloat(canvas.style.left) - panX - 40) < .001 && Math.abs(parseFloat(canvas.style.top) - panY - 30) < .001, "middle drag pan");
    pointer(window, "pointercancel");
    const canceledX = canvas.style.left;
    pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 500, clientY: 450 });
    check(canvas.style.left === canceledX && !$("p-graph").classList.contains("panning"), "canceled pan removes gesture listeners");
    check(graphStaysFixed(), "pan does not resize the graph panel");
    const cardRect = firstCard.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer(firstCard, "pointerdown", { clientX: cardRect.left + 15, clientY: cardRect.top + 15 });
    pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: cardRect.left + 15, clientY: graphRect.bottom - cardRect.height + 5 });
    const lowerCard = firstCard.getBoundingClientRect();
    check(document.elementFromPoint(lowerCard.left + 20, lowerCard.bottom - 10)?.closest(".gcard") === firstCard, "nodes remain visible and interactive at the bottom of the graph");
    check(graphStaysFixed(), "moving nodes does not resize the graph panel");
    pointer(window, "pointercancel");
    $("p-zoom-fit").click();
    check(graphStaysFixed() && [...canvas.querySelectorAll(".gcard, .gcmd")].every((node) => {
      const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.left >= graphRect.left && rect.top >= graphRect.top && rect.right <= graphRect.right + 1 && rect.bottom <= graphRect.bottom + 1;
    }), "fit uses the visible graph viewport");
    const buttonCard = canvas.querySelector('[data-id="cmd-button"]');
    const markdownCard = canvas.querySelector('[data-id="cmd-md"]');
    check(buttonCard.querySelector(".gcmd-btn").textContent === "실행" && !markdownCard.querySelector(".gcard-handle"), "button has run action and Markdown is a terminal node");
    // 오류는 alert 대신 화면 안 오류 알림(.error-toast)으로 보인다.
    const toastText = () => [...document.querySelectorAll(".error-toast")].map((toast) => toast.textContent).join("\n");
    document.querySelectorAll(".error-toast").forEach((toast) => toast.remove());
    const handle = firstCard.querySelector(".gcard-handle");
    const fromRect = handle.getBoundingClientRect(), toRect = buttonCard.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer(handle, "pointerdown", { clientX: fromRect.x + fromRect.width / 2, clientY: fromRect.y + fromRect.height / 2 });
    pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: toRect.x + 60, clientY: toRect.y + 50 });
    pointer(window, "pointerup", { clientX: toRect.x + 60, clientY: toRect.y + 50 });
    check(toastText().includes("버튼 노드") && toastText().includes("연결 실패") && !$("link-dialog").open, "graph rejects incoming links to manual button nodes in an in-app error");
    document.querySelectorAll(".error-toast").forEach((toast) => toast.remove());
    pointer(firstCard, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    pointer(command, "pointerdown", { ctrlKey: true }); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    check(firstCard.classList.contains("selected") && command.classList.contains("selected"), "mixed session and command selection");
    check($("p-flow-assistant-status").textContent === "선택 2개 함께 보냄", "flow assistant shows how many selected cards it will include");
    const firstX = parseFloat(firstCard.style.left), commandX = parseFloat(command.style.left);
    pointer(firstCard, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 398 });
    check(parseFloat(firstCard.style.left) > firstX && parseFloat(command.style.left) > commandX, "selected group drag");
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("blur"));
    check(parseFloat(firstCard.style.left) === firstX && parseFloat(command.style.left) === commandX, "blur restores canceled group positions");
    pointer(firstCard, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 390 });
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "sessions" }) });
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
    check($("p-graph").querySelector(".graph-canvas") === canvas, "live redraw defers during gesture");
    pointer(window, "pointerup");
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelector(".graph-canvas") !== canvas);
    check(true, "live redraw resumes after gesture");
    const ctrlKey = (key, extra = {}) => (document.activeElement ?? document).dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...extra }));
    await until(() => !$("p-undo").disabled);
    check($("p-undo").title.includes("카드 2개 이동") && $("p-redo").disabled, "moving cards records an undoable step");
    ctrlKey("z");
    await until(() => !$("p-redo").disabled);
    check($("p-redo").title.includes("카드 2개 이동"), "Ctrl+Z undoes the card move");
    ctrlKey("y");
    await until(() => $("p-redo").disabled && $("p-undo").title.includes("카드 2개 이동"));
    check(true, "Ctrl+Y redoes the card move");
    $("p-flow-assistant-prompt").focus();
    ctrlKey("z");
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    check($("p-redo").disabled, "Ctrl+Z inside a text field keeps the text editor's own undo");
    $("p-flow-assistant-prompt").blur();
    $("p-tabs").querySelector('[data-tab="sessions"]').click();
    check(!document.querySelector('[data-panel="sessions"]').hidden && $("p-sessions").querySelectorAll("tbody tr").length === 2, "project sessions tab");
    $("p-tabs").querySelector('[data-tab="git"]').click();
    await until(() => $("g-graph").querySelector(".git-graph-row"));
    check($("g-branch").textContent === "main", "git panel controller and view");
    $("g-tab-history").click();
    check(!$("g-history").hidden, "git history tab");
    $("open-settings").click();
    await until(() => $("settings-dialog").open);
    check($("project-list").children.length === 1, "settings view");
    check($("cli-auto-update").checked, "CLI automatic updates default to enabled");
    $("cli-auto-update").checked = false;
    $("settings-form").requestSubmit($("settings-form").querySelector('button[value="ok"]'));
    await until(() => !$("settings-dialog").open);
    $("open-settings").click(); await until(() => $("settings-dialog").open);
    check(!$("cli-auto-update").checked, "disabled automatic update preference survives reopening settings");
    $("cli-auto-update").checked = true;
    $("settings-form").requestSubmit($("settings-form").querySelector('button[value="ok"]'));
    await until(() => !$("settings-dialog").open);
    $("open-setup").click();
    await until(() => $("setup-dialog").open && $("setup-list").children.length === 2);
    check($("setup-list").textContent.includes("실행 확인 실패") && $("setup-list").textContent.includes("C:/fixture/codex.cmd") && !$("setup-list").textContent.includes("로그인됨"), "CLI execution failure shows its selected path without healthy login status");
    const setupCard = (label) => [...$("setup-list").children].find((item) => item.querySelector("b")?.textContent === label);
    const manualDetails = (item) => [...item.querySelectorAll("details")].find((details) => details.querySelector("summary")?.textContent === "수동 설치");
    const wingetCard = () => setupCard("Windows 패키지 관리자 (winget)");
    check(wingetCard() && !wingetCard().textContent.includes("로그인"), "winget has its own setup card without login actions");
    check([...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].some((button) => button.textContent === "설치·복구"), "winget offers automatic installation and repair");
    const codexManual = manualDetails(setupCard("Codex"));
    check(codexManual.open && codexManual.textContent.includes("자동 설치에 실패했습니다"), "failed automatic installation expands manual recovery instructions");
    check(codexManual.textContent.includes("‘새로고침’"), "manual installation explains how to refresh CLI detection");
    check(setupCard("Codex").textContent.includes("Fixture installation method is not verified") && ![...setupCard("Codex").querySelectorAll("button")].some((button) => button.textContent === "업데이트"), "unsupported update methods show their reason without offering an update");
    for (const [card, expectedUrl] of [[wingetCard(), "https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/"], [setupCard("Codex"), "https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli/"]]) {
      const manual = manualDetails(card), link = manual.querySelector("a");
      check(link.href === expectedUrl && link.target === "_blank" && link.rel.includes("noopener"), "manual installation keeps its official link in a safe new tab: " + expectedUrl);
      check([...manual.querySelectorAll("button")].some((button) => button.textContent === "명령 복사") && manual.querySelector("pre").textContent.length > 0, "manual installation includes a command and copy button: " + card.querySelector("b").textContent);
    }
    [...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === "설치·복구").click();
    await until(() => wingetCard().querySelector(".setup-job.running"));
    check([...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === "설치·복구").disabled, "winget fixture installation disables repeated starts");
    await until(() => ![...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === "취소")?.disabled);
    [...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === "취소").click();
    await until(() => wingetCard().querySelector(".setup-job.canceled"));
    check(true, "winget cancellation updates its job through the setup event stream");
    $("setup-refresh").click();
    check($("setup-refresh").disabled, "CLI recheck prevents duplicate requests");
    await until(() => !$("setup-refresh").disabled);
    check(true, "CLI recheck completes and restores its button");

    await setupMode({ updateReady: true }); $("setup-refresh").click();
    await until(() => !$("setup-refresh").disabled && setupCard("Codex").textContent.includes("codex 1.0.0"));
    const codexButton = (label) => [...setupCard("Codex").querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === label);
    const updateRequests = async () => (await fixtureRequests()).filter((request) => request.method === "POST" && request.path === "/api/setup/codex/update");
    const updateButton = codexButton("업데이트");
    updateButton.click(); updateButton.click();
    check([...setupCard("Codex").querySelectorAll(".setup-head button")].every((button) => button.disabled), "pending update immediately disables all tool actions");
    await until(async () => (await updateRequests()).length === 1 && setupCard("Codex").querySelector(".setup-job.running"));
    check($("cli-status").textContent.includes("업데이트 중…"), "CLI status identifies a running update");
    await fetch("/fixture/release-update", { method: "POST" });
    await until(() => setupCard("Codex").querySelector(".setup-job.error") && !codexButton("업데이트 다시 시도")?.disabled);
    check(setupCard("Codex").textContent.includes("Fixture update failed") && codexButton("새로고침"), "failed update keeps its error and offers refresh and retry");

    const freshRequests = (requests, endpoint) => requests.filter((request) => request.method === "GET" && request.path === "/api/" + endpoint && request.search === "?fresh=1");
    const beforeRefreshFailure = await fixtureRequests();
    await setupMode({ refreshFailure: true });
    const cardRefresh = codexButton("새로고침");
    cardRefresh.click(); cardRefresh.click(); $("setup-refresh").click();
    check($("setup-refresh").disabled && codexButton("확인 중…")?.disabled, "refresh disables the global and failed-card controls together");
    await until(() => !$("setup-refresh").disabled && $("setup-list").textContent.includes("Fixture setup refresh failed"));
    check(["status", "auth", "setup"].every((endpoint) => $("setup-list").textContent.includes("Fixture " + endpoint + " refresh failed")), "refresh reports every failed check inline");
    check(setupCard("Codex").querySelector(".setup-job.error") && wingetCard(), "refresh failure preserves tool cards and the previous failed update");
    const afterRefreshFailure = await fixtureRequests();
    check(["status", "auth", "setup"].every((endpoint) => freshRequests(afterRefreshFailure, endpoint).length === freshRequests(beforeRefreshFailure, endpoint).length + 1), "duplicate refresh clicks issue only one fresh request per endpoint");
    check((await updateRequests()).length === 1, "refresh does not retry a failed update automatically");

    await setupMode({ refreshFailure: false }); $("setup-refresh").click();
    await until(() => !$("setup-refresh").disabled && !$("setup-list").querySelector(':scope > [role="alert"]'));
    check(codexButton("업데이트 다시 시도") && !codexButton("업데이트 다시 시도").disabled, "successful refresh clears the fetch error and leaves update retry available");
    const retryButton = codexButton("업데이트 다시 시도");
    retryButton.click(); retryButton.click();
    await until(async () => (await updateRequests()).length === 2 && setupCard("Codex").querySelector(".setup-job.running"));
    check([...setupCard("Codex").querySelectorAll(".setup-head button")].every((button) => button.disabled), "retry blocks duplicate tool actions while its request is pending");
    await fetch("/fixture/release-update", { method: "POST" });
    await until(() => setupCard("Codex").querySelector(".setup-job.done") && !codexButton("업데이트")?.disabled);
    check(setupCard("Codex").textContent.includes("업데이트 확인을 마쳤습니다.") && !setupCard("Codex").querySelector(".setup-job.running") && !$("cli-status").textContent.includes("업데이트 중…"), "latest setup read preserves terminal completion when the POST returns an older running state");
    $("setup-dialog").close();
    $("session-list").querySelector("button").click();
    await until(() => !$("view-session").hidden && $("s-title").textContent === "First");
    check($("s-events").querySelector(".md")?.textContent.includes("Hello"), "session conversation rendering");
    check($("s-form").getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= innerHeight && getComputedStyle($("s-prompt")).resize === "none", "session composer remains inside the window without manual resizing");
    $("s-diff").click();
    await until(() => $("diff-dialog").open);
    check($("diff-status").textContent.includes("fixture.txt") && $("diff-body").textContent.includes("fixture change"), "session diff loads through controller");
    $("diff-dialog").close();
    $("s-prompt").value = "keep my draft";
    const promptNode = $("s-prompt");
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "event", payload: { sessionId: "s1", event: { seq: 1, kind: "text", text: "live fragment" } } }) });
    await until(() => $("s-events").textContent.includes("live fragment"));
    check($("s-prompt") === promptNode && promptNode.value === "keep my draft", "stream append preserves composer draft and node identity");
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "state", payload: { sessionId: "s1", state: "running", runningStartedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }) });
    await until(() => $("s-state").textContent === "실행 중");
    check($("s-events").classList.contains("running") && !$("s-elapsed").hidden, "live execution state updates list and detail");
    window.dispatchEvent(new PageTransitionEvent("pagehide", { persisted: true }));
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "event", payload: { sessionId: "s1", event: { seq: 2, kind: "text", text: "after back-forward cache" } } }) });
    await until(() => $("s-events").textContent.includes("after back-forward cache"));
    check(true, "back-forward cache preserves live updates");
    $("s-prompt").value = "";
    $("s-prompt").dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    check($("s-send").textContent.includes("일시중지"), "composer tracks live running state");
    await fetch("/api/sessions/s1", { method: "PUT", body: JSON.stringify({ locked: true }) });
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "sessions" }) });
    await until(() => $("view-session").hidden && !$("view-project").hidden);
    check(!$("s-events").children.length && !$("s-prompt").value, "locking from another window removes the open conversation");
    let lockedCard = $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"]');
    lockedCard.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("dblclick", { bubbles: true }));
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
    check($("view-session").hidden, "locked graph card cannot open chat");
    lockedCard = $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"]');
    const lockButton = lockedCard.querySelector(".session-lock");
    pointer(lockButton, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointerup"); lockButton.click();
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"] .session-lock')?.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "false");
    check(!$("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"]').classList.contains("selected"), "lock icon toggles without selecting or dragging card");
    $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("dblclick", { bubbles: true }));
    await until(() => !$("view-session").hidden);
    check($("s-events").textContent.includes("Hello"), "unlock restores conversation access");
    [...$("session-list").querySelectorAll(".session-item")].find((item) => item.textContent.includes("Second")).click();
    await until(() => $("s-title").textContent === "Second");
    $("s-prompt").value = "another session's draft";
    await fetch("/api/sessions/s1", { method: "PUT", body: JSON.stringify({ locked: true }) });
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "sessions" }) });
    await until(() => $("session-list").querySelector('.session-item-row.locked'));
    $("session-list").querySelector('.session-item-row.locked .session-item').click();
    check(!$("view-session").hidden && $("s-title").textContent === "Second" && $("s-prompt").value === "another session's draft", "opening a locked session preserves another open session and its draft");
    $("session-list").querySelector('.session-item-row.locked .session-lock').click();
    await until(() => !$("session-list").querySelector('.session-item-row.locked'));
    $("nav-dashboard").click(); $("nav-chat").click();
    check(!$("view-chat").hidden && $("c-title").textContent === "새 채팅", "new chat navigation");
    const openNewSession = async () => {
      // Let the previous dialog's queued close event finish before reopening it.
      await new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
      $("open-new-top").click();
      await until(() => $("new-dialog").open && !$("new-submit").disabled);
    };
    const setWorktree = (value) => {
      $("new-isolate").value = String(value);
      $("new-isolate").dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
    };
    const setWorktreeName = (value) => {
      $("new-worktree-name").value = value;
      $("new-worktree-name").dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
    };
    const controlIsVisible = (id) => {
      const control = $(id), rect = control.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && rect.top >= 0 && rect.bottom <= innerHeight &&
        document.elementFromPoint(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2) === control;
    };
    const submitNewSession = async (title) => {
      $("new-title").value = title;
      check($("new-form").checkValidity(), "session form is valid: " + title);
      $("new-form").requestSubmit($("new-submit"));
      await until(() => !$("new-dialog").open && !$("new-submit").disabled);
    };
    await openNewSession();
    check($("new-isolate").tagName === "SELECT" && $("new-isolate").value === "false" && $("new-worktree-name").disabled && !$("new-worktree-name").required, "new session explicitly defaults to no worktree");
    check($("new-project").closest("label").nextElementSibling.contains($("new-isolate")), "worktree choice appears immediately after the project");
    check(controlIsVisible("new-isolate"), "worktree choice is visible and accessible when the dialog opens");
    await submitNewSession("Default workspace");

    await openNewSession();
    setWorktree(true);
    check(!$("new-worktree-mode-row").hidden && !$("new-worktree-row").hidden && $("new-worktree-name").required && !$("new-worktree-name").disabled, "explicit worktree selection requires a name");
    check(controlIsVisible("new-isolate") && controlIsVisible("new-worktree-name"), "worktree choice and name stay visible after opting in");
    check(!$("new-form").checkValidity(), "native form validation blocks an unnamed worktree");
    setWorktreeName("  browser-worktree  ");
    await submitNewSession("Separate workspace");

    await openNewSession();
    check($("new-isolate").value === "false" && $("new-worktree-name").value === "" && $("new-worktree-mode").value === "new", "successful creation resets workspace selection on reopen");
    setWorktree(true); setWorktreeName("stale-worktree"); setWorktree(false);
    check($("new-worktree-name").disabled && !$("new-worktree-name").required && $("new-worktree-row").hidden, "turning worktrees off removes the name requirement");
    await submitNewSession("Worktree disabled");

    await openNewSession();
    setWorktree(true); setWorktreeName("canceled-worktree");
    $("new-dialog").close();
    await openNewSession();
    check($("new-isolate").value === "false" && $("new-worktree-name").value === "" && $("new-worktree-name").disabled, "canceling and reopening clears workspace selection");
    setWorktree(true); setWorktreeName("chat-worktree");
    $("new-agent").value = "codex-chat"; $("new-agent").dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
    check($("new-isolate").value === "false" && $("new-isolate").disabled && $("new-worktree-name").disabled && !$("new-worktree-name").required, "chat mode clears and disables workspace selection");
    await submitNewSession("Chat without workspace");

    $("project-nav").querySelector("button").click();
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s2"]') && $("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd"));
    const assistantCard = $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"]');
    pointer(assistantCard, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    check($("p-flow-assistant-send").disabled, "flow assistant needs a request before sending");
    $("p-flow-assistant-prompt").value = "리뷰 세션 붙여 줘";
    $("p-flow-assistant-prompt").dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
    $("p-flow-assistant-prompt").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Enter", bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
    await until(() => !$("p-flow-assistant-plan").hidden && $("p-flow-assistant-steps").children.length === 2);
    check($("p-flow-assistant-summary").textContent === "리뷰 세션을 붙입니다." && $("p-flow-assistant-steps").textContent.includes('새 세션 "리뷰" 만들기'), "Enter asks the flow assistant and previews its actions");
    check(!$("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="rev"]') && !$("p-flow-assistant-apply").disabled, "previewed actions wait for approval");
    $("p-flow-assistant-apply").click();
    await until(() => $("p-flow-assistant-plan").hidden && $("p-flow-assistant-status").textContent.includes("2개 작업을 적용"));
    check($("p-flow-assistant-prompt").value === "", "applying clears the request");
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s2"]') && $("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd"));
    const removable = $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s2"]');
    const retained = $("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd");
    pointer(removable, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    pointer(retained, "pointerdown", { ctrlKey: true }); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    const savedConfirm = window.confirm;
    let confirmations = 0;
    window.confirm = () => { confirmations++; return true; };
    const editor = document.createElement("input"); $("p-graph").append(editor);
    editor.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true }));
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true, repeat: true }));
    $("new-dialog").showModal();
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true }));
    check(confirmations === 0, "Delete ignores editors repeated keys and open dialogs");
    $("new-dialog").close(); editor.remove();
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true }));
    await until(() => toastText().includes("locked"));
    const deletionToast = document.querySelector(".error-toast");
    check(deletionToast.querySelector(".error-report-action").textContent === "노드 삭제 실패" && deletionToast.querySelector(".error-report-raw pre").textContent.includes("locked") && !!deletionToast.querySelector(".error-report-copy") && !deletionToast.querySelector(".error-report-ask"), "partial deletion shows action, raw detail and copy without an unrelated AI request");
    deletionToast.querySelector(".error-report-close").click();
    check(!document.querySelector(".error-toast"), "error toast closes");
    check(confirmations === 1 && !$("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s2"]'), "Delete removes the selected fixture session with one confirmation");
    check($("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd").classList.contains("selected"), "failed command deletion retains selection");
    window.confirm = savedConfirm;
    $("p-tabs").querySelector('[data-tab="flow"]').click();

    return checks;
  })()
